description.narrative: The Innovation Campus Project aims to enable the next-generation labour force to work with future-shaping technologies, provide young people with the technical skills they need to thrive in and lead the 4th Industrial Revolution, and accelerate Türkiye’s digital transformation by addressing the skills gap. On 6 February 2023, two devastating earthquakes, measuring 7.7 and 7.6 magnitude on the Richter Scale, struck Kahramanmaras, Türkiye. Impacts have been felt across ten provinces in Türkiye and have caused catastrophic devastation, with at least 14 million people directly impacted in Türkiye. The programme will contribute to the training of disadvantaged young people with a priority given to the youth displaced by the earthquake , on advanced technologies (such as AI, IoT and Big Data)UNDP IICPSD’s SDG AI Lab will support the programme by complementing Samsung’s AI Training curriculum through bridging these technologies with SDGs.
